description: This file contains SQL schema definitions for setting up the database structure of the Decision Replay Platform. It includes table creation for users, authentication, roles, decisions, outcomes, tags, embeddings metadata, analytics snapshots, audit logs, and seed data for initial setup. It defines constraints, indexes, triggers, and initial data relevant to the backend database layer.

methods.name: set_updated_at
methods.description: A trigger function that updates the 'updated_at' timestamp to the current time whenever a row is modified.

calls: CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS pgcrypto
CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS citext
search-terms: seed data initial roles and demo user
